arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Fisher argued the system contains the same flaws as the system invalidated in Ring versus Arizona.
Mr. Dreeben argued sentencing guidelines regularize the process and differ from systems considered in Apprendi and Ring.
Mr. Fisher stated the Washington legislature did not allow judges to depart upward for any reason.
